plates.subject: A small neighbourhood corner grocery store with a striped awning, crates of fruit by the entrance, a shopping cart, a bench and a lamp post on the sidewalk, a quiet road curving past the front of the tile.

A suburban street intersection with a parked car whose driver door hangs open and hazard lights blink, a fallen bicycle, a spilled paper grocery bag with oranges rolling on the asphalt, hedges and a fire hydrant.

A long straight suburban road running diagonally across the tile from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner, ending at a small two-storey house whose porch light glows warm at the far top-right end. Along the road an overturned car with blinking hazard lights, a sedan crashed into a bent lamp post, a trash bin smouldering orange, scattered newspapers, one flickering streetlight casting a cone of light, the lane down the middle clear and open.
The front porch of a cosy two-storey wooden house, three wooden steps up to a heavy front door, a single warm porch light, a doormat, potted plants, an open picket fence gate in the foreground.

A small cosy living room: on the left wall the front door secured with a chain and two deadbolts, on the right wall a window with wooden boards nailed across it and moonlight leaking through the gaps, an old CRT television glowing on a low cabinet, a worn sofa, a rug, a floor lamp, a side table with a flashlight.
